Game Testers of Voat, how does the actual job compare to the movie Grandma's Boy?
Here is a site filled with stories written by game testers, both good and bad.

From everything I've read, game testing is a mind numbing activity where you do things over again and again and again while altering the parameters slightly, just to find bugs. It's not really fun at all and game testers get treated like disposable employees, because they ARE disposable employees. They basically get treated like shit and do shit work. Basically, imagine running through Rainbow Road on Mario Kart Number Whatever all day with every racer. All day. 8 hours straight of playing Rainbow Road. Then the next day, if you're lucky, you might get to test a new track. Or they want you to re-test certain conditions on Rainbow Road again because you found some bugs the other day. Or you just didn't finish going through your list of conditions and now your boss is yelling at you for not testing fast enough.

tl;dr it is not fun or rewarding at all from everything i've read.
